audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty is rated 7.5/10 TRICKY against a 56.3% win rate over 817 games, and the chart contradicted it by handing Tryndamere four rows.
audit.why: The chart itself is the packet's and the mirror aligned to it; the rating is the outlier. I left diffRating alone rather than swing it without the mirror's agreement, and flagged it.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned; rating question recorded for the user.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 disagreed with the packet chart and with the mirror, and whys[4] described 'Level 5' while sitting on the Level 6 row.
audit.why: Level 6 is even, not hers: Lilting Lullaby only affects enemies already carrying Dream Dust, so if she has not landed a spell on you, a 150-second ultimate does nothing.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Tryndamere / Skill / Tryndamere / Skill / Tryndamere / Tryndamere in matched pairs, ratings adjusted, whys[4] relabelled and re-grounded on Dream Dust.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] told the reader to run her down 'whenever her E dash is on cooldown'. Lillia has no dash. Nothing on the page carried a cooldown or a range.
audit.why: Swirlseed is a 700-range projectile on 12s that rolls until it hits a wall or a target — it is a slow, not a dash. Blooming Blows is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4 at 450 and its true damage lands on the outer edge, so standing close to her reduces it. Watch Out! Eep! is 14/13/12/11/10 and hits hardest in the centre. Lilting Lullaby is 150/130/110 at 1600 range and requires Dream Dust on the target.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, spikes[1], spikes[2], early and five phase whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mocking Shout's facing condition was absent against the one champion in the lane built entirely on move speed.
audit.why: It cuts AD in an 850 radius but slows only enemies with their backs turned, so a Lillia kiting toward you while stacking Blooming Blows takes no slow from it at all.

edits.before: Spin up fury on the wave before contesting anything. Identify how Lillia contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Spin up fury on the wave. Blooming Blows puts its true damage on the outer edge — stand close to her and it hits you for less.

edits.before: E lets you spin in and out of exchanges on your terms. Only take the trade when Lillia's Blooming Blows is down.
edits.after: Blooming Blows is 6s at rank 1 and stacks her move speed as it lands. Trade inside the gap, then let the wave carry.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Lillia must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Watch Out! Eep! is 14s at rank 1 and hits hardest dead centre — step off the middle and the trade comes back to you.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Blooming Blows's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Spinning Slash reaches 650 while her poke lives between 450 and 700, so pick the moment she has spent Watch Out! Eep! and close the gap.

edits.before: Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds — dives and coin-flip all-ins become yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Lillia's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby only reaches enemies already carrying her Dream Dust, so if she has not landed a spell on you, her 150-second ultimate has nothing to sleep.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Blooming Blows's cooldown.
edits.after: Stridebreaker helps you stick, but Mocking Shout only slows a turned back — she kites facing you.

edits.before: Level 5 is even because her R and full poke kit give her a pick option if you misstep.
edits.after: Level 6 is even: Lilting Lullaby is a pick only if her Dream Dust is already on you.

edits.before: With lifesteal your Q sustain out-races her DoT poke and you run her down.
edits.after: With lifesteal your Bloodlust out-races her max-health DoT and you run her down.

edits.before: - Lillia Blooming Blows: matchup-defining — Her kite + move speed stacks. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Blooming Blows: 6s at rank 1, and its true damage is on the outer edge, not the centre. - Watch Out! Eep!: 14s, hardest in the middle. - Lilting Lullaby: 150s, and only touches you if Dream Dust is on you.

edits.before: Track Lillia's Blooming Blows: Her kite + move speed stacks. When it is down — Spin in, crit him down.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby needs Dream Dust on you first — take no spell hits and her ultimate has nothing to sleep.

edits.before: Her kite + move speed stacks. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Her move speed stacks as her spells land, so break the chain early.

edits.before: That is Lillia's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: That is Lillia's favourite window — with no fury your crits simply do not land.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Blooming Blows is back in 6 seconds; her mana is the real limit.

edits.before: Her R Lullaby sleep is a pick threat but slow-travelling — you hit 6 too and R Undying Rage lets you tank the sleep-empowered burst and Q back up.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby only lands on enemies already carrying Dream Dust, so deny the spell hit and her 150s ultimate has no target on you. Undying Rage covers the rest.

edits.before: With lifesteal online her magic DoT poke can't out-race your Q sustain; run her down whenever her E dash is on cooldown.
edits.after: With lifesteal online her max-health DoT cannot out-race Bloodlust; she has no dash at all, so run her down once Swirlseed's 12s is spent.

edits.before: Level 1 is a skill window — Lillia's Blooming Blows (Q) gives her movement speed to kite and you have to respect her early poke. Farm safely and don't over-extend into a gank-friendly wave.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — Blooming Blows stacks her move speed as it lands, and Mocking Shout only slows a back that is turned, so it will not catch her kiting toward you. Farm safe and hold the wave.

edits.before: Gap-close with E when her W is down
edits.after: Spin in once Watch Out! Eep! is spent

notes: spikes[2] referred to 'her E dash'; Lillia has no dash in her kit at all — Swirlseed is a rolling projectile that slows. That is the kind of line a reader acts on and loses a duel to. The kit file tags Swirlseed with a terrain flag, but Riot's text says it rolls until it hits a wall or target rather than creating one, so I did not repeat the missing-interaction headline about her cutting your retreat with terrain.
